permitTrigger.explanation: A permit is treated as required for building-mounted collectors with an aggregate face area of at least 5 square metres.

questions.text: Will the panels be mounted on a building or structure?
What is the total face area of all the panels?
questions.help: Add up the area of every panel. A typical panel is about 2 square metres.

questions.text: Has an engineer said the roof needs strengthening?
questions.help: Answer 'Not sure' if you don't have a structural review yet.

requirements.label: Solar panel location plan
requirements.plainLanguage: A roof plan showing where the panels go and how they attach to the roof structure.

details.label: Solar panel locations
details.whereToAdd: Roof plan: draw where the panels go and the total panel area.

details.label: Existing roof-member sizes and spacing
details.missingMessage: Existing structural information is missing. Identify the existing roof-member sizes and spacing.
details.whereToAdd: Roof plan: label the existing rafters or trusses with size and spacing.

details.label: Supporting roof-element locations
details.missingMessage: Support locations are not shown. Identify where the mounting system connects to the supporting roof elements.
details.whereToAdd: Roof plan: mark where the mounting system attaches to the rafters or trusses.

requirements.label: Professional engineer structural review
requirements.plainLanguage: A review of your existing roof by a professional engineer, confirming it can carry the panels or describing any strengthening.
requirements.missingMessage: Structural review is missing. Add the professional engineer’s review of the existing roof and supporting structure.

details.label: Engineer review of roof and supporting structure
details.missingMessage: Structural review is missing. Add the professional engineer’s review of the existing roof and supporting structure.
details.whereToAdd: Structural review letter, signed and sealed by a professional engineer.

details.label: Statement of whether strengthening is required
details.missingMessage: Strengthening requirements are unclear. Indicate whether supplementary construction is required.
details.whereToAdd: Structural review: state whether the roof needs strengthening.

details.label: Required supplementary construction details
details.whereToAdd: Structural review: add drawings of the strengthening work.

requirements.label: Mounting details and specifications
requirements.plainLanguage: Details of the mounting system: how it attaches, fastener sizes and spacing, and rail spans.

details.label: Mounting details
details.whereToAdd: Mounting system document: include the mounting detail drawing.

details.label: Fastener sizes and spacing
details.missingMessage: Fastening information is incomplete. Provide the proposed fastener sizes and spacing.
details.whereToAdd: Mounting system document: list fastener size and spacing.

details.label: Rail and support information
details.missingMessage: Mounting details are incomplete. Add the rail and support information.
details.whereToAdd: Mounting system document: give rail sizes and support spacing (spans).

details.label: Mounting-system specifications
details.whereToAdd: Attach the mounting system manufacturer's specification sheet.

requirements.label: Panel manufacturer specifications
requirements.plainLanguage: The manufacturer's specification sheet for the solar panels.

details.label: Panel manufacturer specifications
details.whereToAdd: Attach the panel manufacturer's specification sheet.
